title: A new home for my work
text: I rebuilt this site with Quarto so that the analyses I write for coursework and research can be published directly, without copying results into a page builder by hand. I write a .qmd file, render it, and it shows up here.

title: A new home for my work
text:
How posts work
Every post lives in its own folder under posts/, with an index.qmd inside. The front matter at the top sets the title, date, and categories, and the blog listing picks it up automatically.

title: A new home for my work
text:
What is next
More posts as the semester goes on — mostly notes on econometrics and on the tools I use to get from raw data to a finished write-up.

When you want the code to actually run and show its output, use a curly-brace chunk. The block below is shown as an example only — see the cheat sheet in this project for how to turn on live code:
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, colour = class)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Engine displacement", y = "Highway MPG")
